name: best-clima-relatorios
description: Protótipo local de relatórios Best Clima
author: Best Clima

scripts.build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build
scripts.start: npm run build -- --emptyOutDir false && node node_modules/electron/cli.js .
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --win portable
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && node node_modules/electron-builder/cli.js --mac dmg
